Keep the PC awake, control your displays and save battery.
The PC follows its normal energy rules
Starts when any selected condition is active.
Pause while the PC is locked
Follows normal sleep rules while locked and resumes the remaining session after you unlock.
Starts a session with the default duration.
Keeps the PC awake while the display follows its normal sleep timer.
During a session, moves the pointer a little at the chosen interval.
Keeps a forgotten session from draining the laptop battery.
Turns Keep awake on or off from any app.
Keep working with the lid closed

“Keep working with the lid closed” sets the laptop lid action to Do nothing while “Keep awake” is active and puts it back automatically when the session ends or the app quits. Prefer using it plugged in.
Turn Bluetooth off when the PC sleeps
Bluetooth already off before sleep is left alone and stays off on wake.
Keeping a battery full while plugged in ages it faster. A notification appears once per charge.

What the notification area and the panel show about your PC, and when to warn you.
Choose what appears next to the icon in the notification area. Each reading is drawn into a small icon; Windows may keep new icons in the overflow until you drag them onto the taskbar.
Nothing is shown next to the icon.
When usage and temperature for the same item are enabled, show them in one icon.
Separate metrics into their own items
Gives each reading its own icon with a label. Off packs two readings per icon so fewer icons are used; usage and temperature stay together when combine is on.
The sliders button at the top of each panel section shows the same choices in place.
Adds manual fan speeds and temperature curves to the tray panel.
Beta. You may run into some bugs.
Committed counts what apps reserved, including the page file.
Read CPU, motherboard and fan sensors

CPU temperatures, motherboard temperatures and fan speeds sit behind the processor and the board's controller, which Windows only lets a kernel driver read. Turning this on lets LibreHardwareMonitor use the signed PawnIO driver (installed separately) while Fieldkit runs as administrator. Fan Control needs it too.
Off. GPU temperature, battery and usage readings still work without it.
Only where the battery reports its temperature.

Alerts fire when their selected limits are reached. CPU use and temperature alerts ignore spikes shorter than about 12 seconds. The repeat setting only limits repeats of the same alert. Alerts appear as Windows notifications (Settings › General › Notifications).

Give the wheel, the side buttons and the touchpad new jobs.
Scroll sideways while holding a key
Hold only the selected modifier to scroll the vertical mouse wheel horizontally. Other key combinations are unchanged.
The touchpad is untouched: it keeps its own Windows scrolling settings.
Focuses the window under the pointer.
Turns each mouse wheel step into a short, gentle glide. The touchpad is not affected.
Every notch of the mouse wheel scrolls the same distance, no matter how fast it spins. The touchpad is not affected.
Turns off Enhance pointer precision so the pointer moves exactly as far as the mouse. Your previous setting returns when this is turned off or Fieldkit quits.
Use side buttons for Back and Forward
Windows already turns the mouse Back and Forward buttons into navigation in File Explorer, browsers and compatible apps. Give them another job under Mouse button shortcuts below.
Each extra button or side-wheel direction can press a key combination for you. While it has a shortcut, it stops doing what it did before.
Switch virtual desktops by dragging a button
Hold the chosen button and drag: left or right moves one desktop over, up opens Task View, down shows the desktop. A short click still does what it always did.
Ignores rapid extra clicks from worn mouse buttons without slowing normal clicks.
Three-finger click acts as middle click
Precision touchpads do this natively: in Touchpad settings, under Three-finger gestures, set Taps to Middle mouse button. Opening links in a new tab and closing tabs then work like a wheel click.
